contact._youtubeHelp: Paste the Aarush Suzuki YouTube channel URL here and rebuild; the header/footer YouTube icon appears automatically. Left empty because no official channel could be found.

_reelsHelp: Reels show as a video-only grid. Without a local MP4 each reel shows Instagram's player cropped to the video (plays on tap). To autoplay muted when visible, put the reel MP4 in site/assets/video/reels/ and set video to /assets/video/reels/<file>.mp4 (optionally a poster image), then rebuild.

forms._help: Optional. A URL that accepts a JSON POST (e.g. https://formspree.io/f/xxxx or https://api.web3forms.com/submit). When empty, forms hand the request to WhatsApp and say so honestly.

analytics._help: Paste IDs and rebuild. ga4 = GA4 Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX): adds Google Analytics with events click_call, click_whatsapp, click_directions, download_brochure, submit_test_ride, submit_service, submit_enquiry. googleVerification / bingVerification = the content value of the Search Console / Bing Webmaster Tools HTML tag (not needed if you verify by DNS).

otp._help: Mobile OTP before any form is sent. Leave widgetId or tokenAuth empty to switch it off. widgetId and tokenAuth come from MSG91 > OTP > Widget (Tokens tab); both are safe to publish. verifyUrl is the Cloudflare Worker address from otp-worker/ (it holds the secret MSG91 authkey and the Formspree link). See OTP-SETUP.md.
